movement_crushed_assimilation_drive_modi.en: With the civil rights movement defeated, the state has accelerated its cultural [concept_assimilation] program.
movement_crushed_assimilation_drive_modi.es: Con el movimiento por los derechos civiles derrotado, el Estado ha acelerado su programa de [concept_assimilation|l] cultural.

movement_crushed_expulsion_modifier_desc.en: The state is actively driving out unwanted minorities, encouraging or forcing their emigration.
movement_crushed_expulsion_modifier_desc.es: El Estado expulsa activamente a las minorías no deseadas, alentando o forzando su emigración.

movement_crushed_order_restored_modifier.en: The civil rights movement has been crushed. Social order is restored, though at the cost of international standing.
movement_crushed_order_restored_modifier.es: El movimiento por los derechos civiles ha sido aplastado. Se ha restablecido el orden social, aunque a costa de la posición internacional.

movement_crushed_political_suppression_m.en: Discriminated communities have been stripped of what little political voice they had.
movement_crushed_political_suppression_m.es: A las comunidades discriminadas se les ha arrebatado la poca voz política que tenían.

movement_crushed_segregation_enforced_mo.en: With dissent silenced, the regime has tightened racial and cultural segregation under the full force of law.
movement_crushed_segregation_enforced_mo.es: Con la disidencia silenciada, el régimen ha endurecido la segregación racial y cultural con todo el peso de la ley.
